origin: Codex 0.142.5: the relay runs out of tokens in the middle of the arguments of its second call, the first of which is whole. Codex names no output limit, so the limit is the gateway's own default (16,000 tokens unless the operator set another, and no more than the model writes; D14): the answer lost a call to it, which is held back as the answer that lost its only call is (WITHHELD: a 502 that is not charged, and not a failure of the relay; the relay is kept from the session), and the client's retry reaches Kiro, which is held to the same 16,000 tokens (design 7.10, D11, D14). The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
